(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.player.video.pause(); __app.showTab('together'); document.querySelector('.page[data-page=together] .btn.primary').click(); for(let i=0;i<20;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); if(document.querySelector('.invite .code')?.textContent) break; } return 'CODE[' + document.querySelector('.invite .code')?.textContent + ']'; })()

(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<120;i++){ const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].find(x=>/wants to join/.test(x.innerText)); if(m){ [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Allow').click(); return 'allowed'; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } return 'no approval prompt'; })()

(async()=>{ const i=document.querySelector('.page[data-page=together] input[placeholder^=Say]'); i.value='hello from host'; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter'})); return 'sent'; })()

(async()=>{ __app.showTab('player'); __app.player.video.play(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); __app.player.togglePlay(); __app.player.seekTo(3); __app.showTab('together'); return 'host paused at ' + __app.player.video.currentTime.toFixed(1); })()

(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<60;i++){ if(/hi from guest/.test(document.querySelector('.chat').innerText)) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.member').length + ' members; chat: ' + document.querySelector('.chat').innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' / '); })()
